say:1:1230426001:1.text: We are. This is one of the conditions for reconciling with the Carmine Whispers.
say:1:1230426001:1.source_cn: 当然，这是我们和血薇帮和解的要求之一。
say:1:1230426001:1.male: We are. This is one of the conditions for reconciling with the Carmine Whispers.
say:1:1230426001:1.female: We are. This is one of the conditions for reconciling with the Carmine Whispers.

say:2:1230426002:1.text: Actually, I'd leave even if I'm not asked to do so.
say:2:1230426002:1.source_cn: 就算血薇帮不提，我也早就想离开这里了。
say:2:1230426002:1.male: Actually, I'd leave even if I'm not asked to do so.
say:2:1230426002:1.female: Actually, I'd leave even if I'm not asked to do so.

say:3:1230426003:1.text: You have no idea the ladies are such tough cookies.
say:3:1230426003:1.source_cn: 你是不知道小水村的那群女人有多厉害。
say:3:1230426003:1.male: You have no idea the ladies are such tough cookies.
say:3:1230426003:1.female: You have no idea the ladies are such tough cookies.
